description: Sanitary Sewer Overflows is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. Sanitary Sewer Overflows (SSO) are releases of untreated sewage into the environment. City of Bloomington Utilities Department records and maintains data for all SSO events that occur within Bloomington's wastewater collection and treatment system. Additionally, each event is reported to the Indiana Department of Environmental Management. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The portal files it under the category Utilities & Water. The table has 10 columns. Attribution on the portal: Utilities. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
